rows.TEXT: My wares can help you in your quest.
My spells are the most potent in the region.

Highest lord of the dwarf lords, he is known for his intensity in battle and his courage in the face of overwhelming odds. He once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.

Known in his times as the mightiest of all adepts of the black art, this lord was slain by the inquisitor Vorgel who ended his reign of terror. He is now resurrected as an undead with the intention to subjugate every mortal to his will.

Devotee of the Heretic Cult 
"If you are not with us then you are against us! Soon, everyone will be under the spell of Synclair...the Heretic cult will rule the land!"

Devotee of the Heretic Cult 
"No one shall live to see the face of Synclair! The child Solaris will be protected! Praise Scyon!"

Loremaster 
"The Demon spreads his hatred through the rivers of Unity... The Demon's hatred for all living creatures is as deep as the waters themselves. Scyon destroys anyone who dares to approach him."

Devotee to the Heretic Cult 
"Death to the outsiders!"

Devotee of the Heretic Cult 
"Let the cold winds stop all those who would harm Scyon!"

Spirit of Sophic the Angel 
"My spirit travels through the water... At one time my touch cured the weak! Synclair of the Heretic Cult absorbed all my power from the waters and now the  magic has been diluted... "

Spirit of Sophic the Angel 
"I am nothing more than a vision from a former time. Not long ago, these very waters held healing properties. Then, one day, the magic vanished! We learned that Synclair and her Heretic cult stole the healing powers."

Spirit of the Unity Angel 
"Scyon and his followers are turning a place of good into a place of evil... I will aid you for the good of Unity."

Spirit of the Unity Angel 
"I will help you to defeat the child of Synclair. Understand this, child - once the Heretic Cult is defeated, you must leave this place!"

Gilgam the Nomad 
"Scyon is the offspring of Synclair the  witch, and the divine healer Solaris... Immunity to many elements and healing abilities are his birthright! These skills  make him a very dangerous adversary."

Calderic 
"Gilgam, why must we search for these people? I say we should conquer the land and find gold. Then we shall be merry and drink ale through the night!"

Gilgam the Nomad 
"Calderic, that is enough! You would be wise to listen to me. Until you prove yourself, I will not allow you to command a full group of my men."

Hu'lyr of the Undead Hordes 
"This entire realm has an unpleasssant stench to it! I feel as though there is sssomething familiar in this realm, familiar lile an old enemy..."

Zythaar 
"I care not to hear your anxieties, fool.  Everyone shall do as I say, for our time is limited. Our enemies can not hide forever!"

Hu' lyr 
"I command you to lisssten and obey. For your outrage I shhhall reduce your command. From now on you shall have little control over our armiesss. Understand that you are no more than a shhheep for me to command!"

Loremaster 
"These books tell of a curse which reigns over this land... Should anyone occupy this castle, evil creatures will return to reclaim it."

Devotee to the Heretic Cult 
"Scyon will not rest until he finds his mother's enemies and destroys them! Scyon and his followers will sacrifice everyone to the river."

Devotee to the Heretic Cult 
"These waters were once blessed by an Angel. The waters used to heal people...but no more, thanks be to the great Scyon! Praise Scyon and worship his evil will!"

Devotee of the Heretic Cult 
"Scyon shall destroy anyone who has entered this city. All Hail the beast Scyon!"

Gilgam the Nomad 
"Through hard work and sacrifice, the Mountain Clans are victorious.We have rid this land of the Heretic Cult. The people of Unity will once again be free to live their lives in peace. May our name live on forever!"

Hu' lyr 
"We have driven off the Heretic cult and defeated Ssscyon! The leader Sssynclair was nowhere to be found. On this day, I assure you that Synclair and the Mountain Clansss have learned that no one can stop the Undead Hordes!"

Heretic Cult Devotee 
"Foolish Undead Hordes! No one can resist Synclair's calling! Join us! Join us and know power! Even now, sheep within your flock desert you..."

Zythaar 
"Now we shall see who is the sheep! Now we shall see who is the lowly one! I shall sever the Undead Hordes with my blade."

Devotee of the Heretic Cult 
"Join us... join us... feel the power flow through your veins! Join us... experience the beauty of Synclair! Feel sanity leave your mind, and in its place - devotion to Synclair!"

Calderic 
"Gilgam, your incompetence shall be rewarded with violence. The edge of my axe will find its mark against all those you command. Then it shall be I who will celebrate alongside the Heretic."

Hu'Lyr  
"There is something familiar about thessse inhabitants. I sense that thisss is the work of the cursed Legions. Something is not right - and I want to discover what it is."

Zythaar 
"The only thing that is not right around here is your leadership. By the power of Mortis, you are nothing more than a fool."

Hu'lyr 
"Zythaar, I have warned you not to mock my authority! Once this mission is completed you shhhall be punished a thousand timesss over. Never mention Mortis's name again, lowly one."

Hu' Lyr 
"I now know what is the matter! Just asss we have the citizens of Unity have been affected by this Heretic cult. We mussst find and defeat Scyon before we are doomed!"

Gilgam the Nomad 
"I recognize the smell in these parts...there was once a cult that used brimstone in its ceremonies, creating a form of mind control. This cult must be operating here! We must take care to protect our people..."

Calderic 
"The only foul stench that I sense is the reek of your incompetence. The nerve of you to reduce my leadership and to reprimand me in front of the others! I only tolerate you for the honor of Wotan."

Gilgam the Nomad 
"Calderic, you are trying my patience. Do not question my authority again! I am in charge for I have been to this land before. When this mission is over, you will be confined to your quarters while the rest of us drink and celebrate."

Loremaster 
"The stench has become thicker! The Heretic Cult are to be taken seriously. We have already lost Calderic and I suspect that they will attack us soon."

Devotee of the Heretic Cult 
"The hour is now upon us! Go on, Scyon beast! go forth and destroy our enemies! Praise Scyon!"

Gilgam the Nomad 
"I have learned that we are to capture three cities. Scyon himself should appear if we own them!"

Hu' Lyr 
"We need to capture three cities, only then will Ssscyon appear.We shall destroy the foul beassst when it shows its awful face!"

Huz' lyr 
"Show yourself Ssscyon! The Undead Hordes do not fear you. It is you, Ssscyon, who fear the Undead Hordes."

Hu' Lyr 
"The Heretic cult are planning an assault on us! We mussst be prepared for their attack... They ssseek to take advantage of Ashgan's weakened state!"

Gilgam the Nomad 
"The Heretic cult is planning an attack! We must be prepared for anything..."

Hu' Zar  
"I have ssspoken to the restlesss warriors of the dead.They tell me that we must prepare to defend Ashhhgan. The Heretics are planning to ambushhh our guardian at any time!"

Loremaster 
"We must protect Vithar from the evil Synclair! Synclair's thirst for power is unquenchable... If she sends her servants to defeat Vithar, she may be able to absorb his life power. We must be ready for her!"

Vithar 
"Let the witch come, I grow eager for battle!"

Devotee of the Heretic Cult 
"For the glory of Synclair and to exult Solaris's child - we will bring down our enemies! Praise Synclair!"

Heretic Cult Devotee 
"Praise Synclair and her black heart! Now is the time - fall before our combined might! As you do battle, look upon the face of your former followers and know that your time draws near..."

Devotee of the Heretic Cult 
"Time is marching against you, and soon time shall swallow you whole! Now is the time for Synclair and her followers to take back what belongs to us."

Devotee of the Heretic Cult 
"Go on! Fight a losing battle! We will watch with pleasure as those who first refused us beg to be one with the Heretic Cult! Fight, and with your final efforts know this - Synclair shall be victorious!"

Loremaster 
"We must be ready for all possibilities! Synclair's followers may try to attack our capital and absorb Vithar's power for their twisted cause."

Hun'lyr 
"Synclair! How I hate the sssound of that name! Sssoon, her minions will attack us... Ashgan must be protected from her misguided followersss."

Ashgan 
"We neeeed no protection. Let them come to usss..."

Skeleton 
"There is sssomething that is weakening Ashgan... There is something that is ssstealing his energy - something in the air! I can hear a constant laughter emanating  from a far off place. An icy, cackling laughter!"

Gilgam the Nomad 
"Vithar is weakening...there is something in the air. I suspect the brimstone is stealing Vithar's energy. We must be on guard at all times! We have no way to know what his stolen energy will be used for!"

Vithar 
"I am fine! Do not concern yourself."

Devotee of the Heretic Cult. 
"Praise Scyon and his glorious rage! Join us - or be destroyed by our followers!"

Devotee to the Heretic Cult 
"With each day the Heretic cult's power grows... There are weak-minded fools everywhere; none are safe from Synclair. In time your precious Vithar will fall before our might."

Gilgam the Nomad 
"The city of Taura is protected by a green-skinned dragon. The dragon appears periodically... It is said that if the city is taken, the dragon appears within a few days to defend it. We must keep Taura city at all costs!"

Hu'nskel 
"I have learned that Ssscyon is looking for his father Solaris! We can lure Scyon by capturing hisss three cities - Suldon, Satoria and Taura. Once these citiesss are ours, Scyon shhhould  try to reclaim them!"

Loremaster 
"To make Scyon come forth we must threaten his lands! If we capture the cities Taura, Satoria and Forest Citadel - Scyon will surely appear to reclaim them!"

Gilgam the Nomad 
"Something is amiss... I suggest that we leave some of our forces in the capital. With Vithar in his weakened state we cannot take any chances!"

Huz' Rala the Death Knight 
"The Heretic cult is dangerous! I insist  that we leave some of our Hordes behind... Ashgan is not at full strength. We cannot take chances when facing the  Heretic cult."

Ashgan 
"It isss fine. Bring usss meat!"

Gilgam the Nomad 
"We need to be prepared at all costs... The Heretic cult will surely attack us while they know Vithar to be weakened. Their mastery of the dark arts is a threat to us. The unholy assault could be upon us at any time!

Hu' Zar 
"Ashgan is weak, and our enemy will surely claim this advantage! We will not be defeated - as we are the Undead Hordes, but be prepared for any foolish attempts against Ashgan!"

Gilgam the Nomad 
"The Heretic cult may have lost this battle, but they will be back! The Undead Hordes are undoubtedly under attack as well. If their capital falls, Synclair will be unstoppable!"

Skeleton 
"We have prevailed in battle! However, I believe that we have yet to see the last of the Heretic cult. The Mountain Clans face a similar battle...if their precious capital falls, the Heretic cult will become too powerful to stop!"

Devotee to the Heretic Cult 
"Foul creatures of the dead! Your presence in our cities sickens me. For your impudence, you shall know eternal suffering."

Devotee of the Heretic Cult 
"No one will survive! No one can destroy Scyon - the beast is immune to earthly power. Feel free to try, you are assured a crushing defeat!"

Heretic Cult devotee 
"Bring down the Undead Hordes and victory shall be ours! So says Scyon!"

Devotee of the Heretic Cult 
"The time has come to smash the once mighty Mountain Clans! Defeat their precious Vithar, and Synclair will feast upon his power!"

Unity 
"I am known by many as the Angel of Unity. The Heretic Cult had imprisoned my spirit in stone. I shall bless this location and your wounds shall be healed from time to time. When you are weak look towards this place and your wounds shall heal."

Sophic 
"I am Sophic, I am an Angel of life. I thank you for freeing my spirit from this firey cave! I have enchanted it so that travellers may rest and heal from time to time."

Loremaster 
"I once read a scroll about the legend of Unity... There were two angels who could no longer bear to see suffering in the world; they transformed an ordinary river into a place of magic! The ailing touched the waters and were cured!"

Warlock 
"This place, called Unity, was once protected by two angels. The angels believed that the sick and the weak should be helped, and they transformed the river... granting it miraculous healing powers!"
